method: Original local composition and synthesis. Magnific Lyria free daily quota unavailable; no credits charged, no service retry. These design prompts describe direction, not successfully AI-generated audio.

tracks.title: Candy Catastrophe
tracks.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL polished instrumental title/menu theme for Deadly Jenga, a joyful chaotic multiplayer VR physics game with shiny candy-plastic avatars, colorful collapsible block towers, giant flying hands, tropical islands and absurd disasters. Its sonic identity is tactile rounded resonant wood/mallet tones, rubbery plucked bass, little tuned pops, warm musical sparkle and playful physical bounce. Sophisticated and catchy rather than nursery music, corporate stock music, circus cliches or obnoxious hyperactive cartoon effects. Instrumental only: absolutely no singing, spoken words, vocal chops or human chants. No borrowed melody or imitation of an existing game soundtrack. Menu-friendly: enough energy to promise mayhem, but comfortable under buttons/conversation; no harsh highs, piercing bells, jump-scare impacts, giant sub drops or long empty cinematic buildup. A memorable compact motif should arrive within the first 3 seconds, evolve through two contrasting sections, then return. End on a repeating pickup into the opening harmony instead of a final grand cadence, fade-out, or trailing silence; aim for a musically loop-friendly ending. Clean spacious stereo mix, controlled bass, clear tune, gentle transients. Duration 90 seconds. Direction: the flagship identity theme. 112 BPM, D major with a sunny Mixolydian twist, bouncy lightly swung 4/4. A short instantly hummable syncopated marimba/wooden-mallet hook, warm round plucked synth bass, palm-muted rhythmic guitar, soft handclaps, rim clicks and springy tuned plastic percussion. Add tiny glittering celesta answers and a restrained playful brass accent in the second section. Tropical joy meeting barely controlled structural chaos. Strong melodic identity, confident groove, playful unexpected rests. Keep it bright but not sugary or frantic. Arrangement: immediate hook, groove development, airy middle contrast, cheerful full return and loop pickup.
